title: prangos ferulacea
intro: Prangos ferulacea, commonly known as Ferula asafoetida or asafoetida, is a perennial plant belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae) that is native to the mountainous regions of Central Asia and the Indian subcontinent. Asafoetida has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat a variety of health issues, including digestive problems, respiratory issues, and wounds, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of asafoetida include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of asafoetida include ferulic acid, asafoetida resin, and volatile compounds like limonene and pinene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
